# ADR 0004: Files in object storage, idempotent by checksum

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Settlement reconciliation engine

## Context

Files are large and must not be processed twice.

## Decision

Store originals in S3/Blob/GCS (a volume on the VPS) keyed by SHA-256; reject re-uploads of the same checksum.

## Consequences

Evidence retained; safe retries.

## Alternatives considered

Storing files in the database.
